verdict.rationale: Kushki is an API-first payments platform. Its docs point to fully server-side integrations, such as a 100% API 3DS flow and direct charges without a client token, plus test data for pre-production use, which together suggest it can be driven programmatically without a UI. The evidence is only page titles, though, and nothing explicitly addresses CI pipelines, headless automation tooling, or a CLI. Missing for 10: explicit headless/CI automation documentation, a CLI or SDK usage guide for pipelines, sandbox credential handling for CI, an OpenAPI spec (probes 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
